baselineDisplay.title: 一颗被拔错的牙齿
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】一颗被拔错的牙齿
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Why did the writer become very worried?
问题：为什么作者很担忧？
• 词汇准备
• pull 拔
• cotton wool 药棉
• collect 搜集
• collection 收藏品，收集品
• nod 点头
• meanwhile 同时
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
牙科医生们总是在你无法作出回答的时候向你提出问题。
My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while. I tried to say something, but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
我的牙科医生刚刚给我拔掉了一颗牙，叫我休息一会儿。我想说点什么，但我嘴里塞满了药棉。
He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
他知道我收集火柴盒，于是问我收藏的火柴盒是否在增加。
He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
接着他又问我的兄弟近来如何，问我是否喜欢伦敦的新工作。
In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
作为对这些问题的回答，我不是点头，就是发出奇怪的声音。
Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been. I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
与此同时，我的舌头正在忙着寻找刚拔掉的那颗牙的伤口。我突然非常着急起来，但却什么也说不出来。
When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth, I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
当那位牙医最后将药棉从我嘴中取出时，我总算有可能告诉他，他拔错了牙。
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Had the dentist in the story pulled out one of the writer’s teeth or not? What had he told him to do?
2 Did he ask several questions or not? Could the writer answer them or not?
3 What was his mouth full of?
4 Did he suddenly discover something wrong or not? Could he say anything or not?
5 What did the dentist eventually remove from his mouth? What did the writer tell him?
Answer: The dentist in the story had pulled out one of the writer’s teeth and (had) told him to rest for a while. He asked several questions but the writer could not answer them. His mouth was full of cotton wool. He suddenly discovered something wrong but he could not say anything. The dentist eventually removed the cotton wool from his mouth and the writer told him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 The writer couldn't speak because ________.
(a) the dentist had just pulled one of his teeth out
(b) the dentist was talking all the time
(c) there was something in his mouth
(d) he had a toothache
2 Why was the writer worried?
(a) He thought the dentist had pulled out more than one tooth.
(b) He thought the dentist had pulled out the wrong tooth.
(c) He had had a tooth out.
(d) His tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
3 It is impossible for him to answer. He _______ answer.
(a) might not
(b) could not
(c) cannot
(d) may not
4 He told me to rest for a while. “________ for while,” he said.
(a) To rest
(b) Rest
(c) Do you rest
(d) Resting
5 He asked me how my brother was. 'How _____?' he asked.
(a) is your brother
(b) your brother was
(c) your brother is
(d) was your brother
6 ________ your new job in London?
(a) It likes you
(b) Does it like you
(c) Do you like
(d) Like you
7 He answered these questions by _______ his head.
(a) to nod
(b) nodding
(c) nod
(d) to nodding
8 He told me to rest for a while. He told me to rest _______.
(a) quietly
(b) for a short time
(c) while he spoke to me
(d) for a long time
9 I have a very good ______ of match boxes.
(a) assembly
(b) gathering
(c) congregation
(d) collection
10 I nodded. This means I _______.
(a) agreed
(b) said no
(c) shouted
(d) whispered
11 Meanwhile my tongue was busy… ________ my tongue was busy…
(a) However
(b) In the mean time
(c) Nevertheless
(d) Although
12 He removed the cotton wool from my mouth. He ________.
(a) took it off
(b) took it in
(c) took it out
(d) took it up
Key: 1 c 2 b 3 c 4 b 5 a 6 c 7 b 8 b 9 d 10 a 11 b 12 c
第三十八单元【语法点拨】 名词性从句
在句中起名词作用的句子称为名词性从句。名词性从句的功能相当于名词词组，在复合句中能充当主语、表语、宾语、补语、同位语等，因此根据其在句中所起的语法作用名词性从句又可分别称为主语从句、宾语从句表语从句和同位语从句,引导这四种从句的从属连词大同小异。
▶ 引导名词性从句的连词
引导名词性从句的连词可分为三类：
• 连词 that：没有词义，在句中不担任成分，仅起连接作用
I believe that she will come to see us. 我相信她会来看我们的。
(that 在句中仅起连接作用，不担任句子成分，可以省略)
That he has lost his work is not true. 他丢了工作不是真的。
(that 在句中不担任成分，仅起连接作用，但不可省略)
• Wh-疑问词：保留疑问词义，在句中担任一个成分。这类词包括 who, whom, when, what, which, where, how 和 why。这些疑问词被称为连接代词或连接副词
Who has taken away my umbrella is unknown. 谁拿走了我的伞还不知道。
(who 具有词义，在句中充当主语，不可省略)
注意：从句法作用的角度考虑，可以把 whether 和 if 归于这一类。这两个连词虽然有词义，但在句中不担任句子成分。
She asked if/whether we wanted drink. 她问我们是否要一杯饮料。
(whether 虽有词义，仅起连接作用，在句中不担任成分)
• 名词性关系词：这一类词不像 wh-疑问词那样具有疑问意义，但是区别于其他关系词。其特点是：它们本身是先行词与另一关系代词或关系副词的结合，因而它所引导的名词性从句是先行词与定语从句的结合
Whoever wants to see the film can go with us this evening.
无论谁想看这你电影今晚可以和我们一起去。 (Whoever wants= Anybody who wants，在句中充当先行词和关系代词的双重作用，是先行词与定语从句的结合)
Do whatever you like. 你喜欢什么，就干什么。
(whatever= the thing which/ that，在句中充当先行词和关系代词的双重作用，是先行词与定语从句的结合)
◆ 名词性关系词包括名词性关系代词、名词性关系副词和名词性关系限定词：
(1)名词性关系代词：
what= the thing(s) which/that
whatever= anything that
whoever= anyone who
whomever= anyone whom
which= the one that
whichever= anyone that
(2)名词性关系副词：
when= the time when
where= the place where
how= the way that
why= the reason why
how 和 why 通常用于表语从句。
(3)名词性关系限定词：
what= any... that /all the.../that/the...that
whatever= any...that
which= any...that/the...that
whichever=any…that

blocks.text: 【故事复现】一颗被拔错的牙齿

• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。

Question: Why did the writer become very worried?
问题：为什么作者很担忧？
• 词汇准备
• pull 拔
• cotton wool 药棉
• collect 搜集
• collection 收藏品，收集品
• nod 点头
• meanwhile 同时

• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。

Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
牙科医生们总是在你无法作出回答的时候向你提出问题。

My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while. I tried to say something, but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
我的牙科医生刚刚给我拔掉了一颗牙，叫我休息一会儿。我想说点什么，但我嘴里塞满了药棉。

He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
他知道我收集火柴盒，于是问我收藏的火柴盒是否在增加。

He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
接着他又问我的兄弟近来如何，问我是否喜欢伦敦的新工作。

In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
作为对这些问题的回答，我不是点头，就是发出奇怪的声音。

Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been. I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
与此同时，我的舌头正在忙着寻找刚拔掉的那颗牙的伤口。我突然非常着急起来，但却什么也说不出来。

When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth, I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
当那位牙医最后将药棉从我嘴中取出时，我总算能够告诉他，他拔错了牙。

• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Had the dentist in the story pulled out one of the writer’s teeth or not? What had he told him to do?
2 Did he ask several questions or not? Could the writer answer them or not?
3 What was his mouth full of?
4 Did he suddenly discover something wrong or not? Could he say anything or not?
5 What did the dentist eventually remove from his mouth? What did the writer tell him?

Answer: The dentist in the story had pulled out one of the writer’s teeth and (had) told him to rest for a while. He asked several questions but the writer could not answer them. His mouth was full of cotton wool. He suddenly discovered something wrong but he could not say anything. The dentist eventually removed the cotton wool from his mouth and the writer told him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.

• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。

1 The writer couldn't speak because ________.
(a) the dentist had just pulled one of his teeth out
(b) the dentist was talking all the time
(c) there was something in his mouth
(d) he had a toothache

2 Why was the writer worried?
(a) He thought the dentist had pulled out more than one tooth.
(b) He thought the dentist had pulled out the wrong tooth.
(c) He had had a tooth out.
(d) His tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.

3 It is impossible for him to answer. He _______ answer.
(a) might not
(b) could not
(c) cannot
(d) may not

4 He told me to rest for a while. “________ for a while,” he said.
(a) To rest
(b) Rest
(c) Do you rest
(d) Resting

5 He asked me how my brother was. 'How _____?' he asked.
(a) is your brother
(b) your brother was
(c) your brother is
(d) was your brother

6 ________ your new job in London?
(a) It likes you
(b) Does it like you
(c) Do you like
(d) Like you

7 He answered these questions by _______ his head.
(a) to nod
(b) nodding
(c) nod
(d) to nodding

8 He told me to rest for a while. He told me to rest _______.
(a) quietly
(b) for a short time
(c) while he spoke to me
(d) for a long time

9 I have a very good ______ of match boxes.
(a) assembly
(b) gathering
(c) congregation
(d) collection

10 I nodded. This means I _______.
(a) agreed
(b) said no
(c) shouted
(d) whispered

11 Meanwhile my tongue was busy… ________ my tongue was busy…
(a) However
(b) In the meantime
(c) Nevertheless
(d) Although

12 He removed the cotton wool from my mouth. He ________.
(a) took it off
(b) took it in
(c) took it out
(d) took it up

第三十八单元【语法点拨】 名词性从句
在句中起名词作用的句子称为名词性从句。名词性从句的功能相当于名词词组，在复合句中能充当主语、表语、宾语、补语、同位语等，因此根据其在句中所起的语法作用名词性从句又可分别称为主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句和同位语从句,引导这四种从句的从属连词大同小异。
▶ 引导名词性从句的连词
引导名词性从句的连词可分为三类：
• 连词 that：没有词义，在句中不担任成分，仅起连接作用

I believe that she will come to see us. 我相信她会来看我们的。
(that 在句中仅起连接作用，不担任句子成分，可以省略)

That he has lost his job is not true. 他丢了工作不是真的。
(that 在句中不担任成分，仅起连接作用，但不可省略)
• Wh-疑问词：保留疑问词义，在句中担任一个成分。这类词包括 who, whom, when, what, which, where, how 和 why。这些疑问词被称为连接代词或连接副词

Who has taken away my umbrella is unknown. 谁拿走了我的伞还不知道。
(who 具有词义，在句中充当主语，不可省略)
注意：whether 和 if 也可引导表示“是否”的间接疑问从句，但不像 who、what 等那样在从句内充当主语或宾语，不能仅因有疑问意义就归为连接代词。

She asked if/whether we wanted a drink. 她问我们是否要一杯饮料。
(whether 虽有词义，仅起连接作用，在句中不担任成分)
• 名词性关系词：这一类词不像 wh-疑问词那样具有疑问意义，但是区别于其他关系词。其特点是：它们本身是先行词与另一关系代词或关系副词的结合，因而它所引导的名词性从句是先行词与定语从句的结合

Whoever wants to see the film can go with us this evening.
想看这部电影的人，今晚都可以和我们一起去。 (Whoever wants= Anybody who wants，在句中充当先行词和关系代词的双重作用，是先行词与定语从句的结合)

Do whatever you like. 你喜欢什么，就干什么。
(whatever= anything that，在句中充当先行词和关系代词的双重作用，是先行词与定语从句的结合)
◆ 名词性关系词包括名词性关系代词、名词性关系副词和名词性关系限定词：
(1)名词性关系代词：

what = the thing(s) which/that
whatever = anything that
whoever = anyone who
whomever = anyone whom（较正式，用法取决于从句内的宾语地位）
whichever = any one that（限定范围内任一个人或物）
注意：普通 which 常用于有明确先行词的关系从句或间接疑问，不能在所有情况下当作 the one that 的替代。
(2)名词性关系副词：

可按具体语境理解：
when：所涉及的时间
where：所涉及的地点
how：方式
why：原因
这些词也可引导间接疑问，不能仅凭词形一律认定为关系结构。
how 和 why 从句可作表语，也可见于宾语等位置，如 I know how it works、I understand why she left。
(3)名词性关系限定词：
what、whatever、whichever 可放在名词前，例如 what money he had、whatever help you need、whichever book you choose。它们的具体含义取决于结构和语境；which + 名词常用于询问或转述有限范围内的选择，不能一律等同 any ... that。
